'''Veelo''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Bad">{{TBB|Bad Territory}}</ref> in the [[Veelo system]] in the [[Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It had a [[atmosphere|Type III]] atmosphere which made it [[death|lethal]] for [[human]]s without protective [[breath mask]]s.<ref name="Bad" /> The surface consisted of severely polluted [[water]]s and [[swamp]]s<ref name="DBVeelo" /> which could be traversed via [[hydroskiff]]s<ref name="DBhydro" /> offered to travelers for a [[Galactic Credit Standard|price]]<ref name="Bad" /> in the [[Veelo docks]],<ref name="DBhydro" /> and teemed with dangerous [[gryzard]]s.<ref name="DBVeelo" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> the [[bounty hunter]] [[Sylar Saris]] took refuge in a [[Sylar's hideout|hideout]] on the planet after being targeted by the [[Haxion Brood]], prompting fellow hunter [[Fennec Shand]] to come to the planet and hunt him down along with [[genetically defective clone]]s [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]].<ref name="Bad" />
